sentences.text: Court No. - 27

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 15434 of 2023
Applicant :- Gyan Chand Kaushal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt.
Home Civil Secrt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kr. Yadav Warsi,Dheeraj Kumar Yadav,Rama Nand Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Santosh Kr. Yadav Warsi, learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Anurag Verma,
learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime
No.0537 of 2020, under Section 409, 419 I.P.C., Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Ayodhya.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant while pressing the bail application submits that after providing an opportunity of being heard to the State, bail application of the applicant was allowed by this Court vide order dated 19.07.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9085 of 2023 after considering all the factual matrix of the case.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9085 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant had approached this Court during the course of investigation and his bail application was rejected by the trial court with regard to other penal sections except Sections 409 and 419 I.P.C., wherein charge sheet has been filed later on and this section could not be mentioned in the bail application moved before the trial court as well as before this Court and now when the applicant had approached the trial court for obtaining bail under Sections 409, 419 I.P.C. also, wherein charge sheet has now been submitted, his prayer of bail has been rejected erroneously.

4. It is further submitted that since this Court had granted bail to the applicant after considering all Gyan Chand Kaushal vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54682311/
1

entities.text: Gyan Chand Kaushal vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: the allegations and material collected in support of the same by the investigating officer, it was obligatory on the part of the trial court to have granted bail to the applicant in Section 409 and 419 I.P.C. also.
5. It is further submitted that criminal history of 9 cases have been explained in para-21 of the bail application.

Applicant is in jail in this case since 27.03.2022 and charge-sheet in this case has already been submitted and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicant may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.

6. Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and having regard to the material/evidence available against the applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail, but could not controvert the other factual submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant.

7. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that during the course of investigation the applicant had approached trial court for the purpose of grant of regular bail, which was rejected and thereafter bail application was moved before this Court,
which was eventually allowed vide order dated 19.07.2023 and he was granted bail pertaining to Case Crime No.0537 of 2020, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 506 and 120-B I.P.C.,
P.S.-Kotwali Nagar, District Ayodhya (Faizabad).
However, it appears that his bail application was allowed by this court on 19.07.2023 and charge sheet has been filed subsequently under sections 409 and 419 I.P.C. also.

Since his bail application was rejected by the trial court when the charge sheet was not submitted, Section 409, 419 I.P.C. could not find place in the bail application filed before this Court and in this eventuality the applicant has now been forced to approach this Court again to get bail under Sections 409 and 419 I.P.C., wherein charge sheet has been subsequently filed.

Perusal of the order dated 19.07.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9084 of 2023 would reveal that this Court after taking into consideration all the factual matrix of the case was pleased to grant the facility of bail to the applicant and since charge sheet has been filed later on under Sections 409 and 419 I.P.C. also and factual matrix have remained the same, in the considered opinion of this Court, facility of bail in added section 409 and 419 I.P.C. may also be extended to the applicant.
8.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9084 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

10. Let the applicant- Gyan Chand Kaushal be released on bail in the aforesaid case, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
